items.title: IT Latency Monitoring & Alerting Platform
items.summary: A real-time platform on Microsoft Fabric that tracks latency across mission-critical enterprise apps and raises alerts before users notice.
items.shows: Real-time data engineering and alerting on Microsoft Fabric
points: Built the platform on Microsoft Fabric (Event Streams, Data Factory, OneLake, Lakehouse) to track latency across mission-critical applications.
Designed event-driven telemetry pipelines and Direct Lake models for near-real-time monitoring.
Added alerting and anomaly detection that flag bottlenecks and escalate issues automatically.
Saved $200K a year and cut issue resolution time by 80%.
